data.headline: Dow futures asset-manager net long falls to 2,080 contracts
data.summary: From November 3 to 10, the asset-manager net long in Dow futures fell by 6,140 contracts while leveraged funds added 495 contracts to their net long. Total open interest declined.

bull.text: The leveraged-fund net long rose from 820 to 1,315 contracts despite a decline in both gross longs and gross shorts. Most of the decline was on the short side.

bear.text: Asset-manager longs fell and shorts increased, cutting the net long from 8,220 to 2,080 contracts. Open interest declined from 87,410 to 83,148 contracts.

watch.text: The thirty-year Treasury yield was 5.46% on November 16, up from 5.26% on November 9. Long-dated borrowing costs also depend on each issuer’s credit spread and financing terms.

limitations: The CFTC report is a November 10 snapshot of Dow futures. These positions are distinct from DIA holdings and flows and do not reveal investor intent.
The Treasury observation is dated November 16. This report has no verified DIA closing price, return, options exposure or dealer gamma.
